name: sovereign-projection
title: Sovereign Projection
definition: A read-only public projection of governed capability. Not a new harness; a composition of viewport, robot, ffmpeg, and publish under the ledger.
first_principles: A projection composes existing harnesses; it never becomes a new plugin
Live capture is pinned as hashed inputs; production replay is deterministic
Every build and publish writes a receipt to the one ledger
QC fails closed; aesthetic judgement stays human
limits: face states are displayed, not wired to a live approval gate
